channel_note: Zero-based file-local channel indices; an index does not define a fluorophore across scans.
policy: Identical frozen predicted-cell/manual-cell intersections, original inferred channels, one-to-one matching within the same cell and channel at 0.6 µm. Unknown regions unscored. No test selection. All eligible references included, even if no network peak. Threshold/checkpoint selected on validation at 90% target precision. Historically reused test fold is exploratory, not an untouched prospective assessment.
